<a id="rules"></a>
## Rules every class shares

- **Global cooldown:** 1s after most skills (tooltips say when a skill does not trigger it).
- **Facing:** casts and swings need the target inside the 180° half-circle in front of you.
- **Diminishing returns:** the same kind of crowd control on one target lasts 100% → 50% → 25% → immune; the count resets after 18s without it. Interrupts have their own school lockout instead.
- **Stealth:** a stealthed rogue is seen within 2 yards; damage or attacking breaks it.
- **Fear:** a feared unit stumbles around at 35% run speed.
- **Out of combat:** 5s without dealing or taking damage.
- **No random damage:** every hit and heal does exactly the number on its tooltip.

<a id="warrior"></a>
## Warrior

Heavy melee fighter. Builds rage by fighting. Charges in, hamstrings, interrupts.

- **Health:** 3400
- **Rage:** 100 max, start with 0; built by dealing damage (15% of it with a free skill or auto-attack) and taking damage (7.5%), and drains 5 a second out of combat
- **Specs:** [Warbringer](#warrior-arms) (Dual wield) · [Rampager](#warrior-fury) (Two-handed sword) · [Barbarian](#warrior-protection) (Control / reach)

**Talents every Warrior spec shares** (one pick per tier, kept when you change spec):

| Tier | Talent | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| I | 📌 **Pinning Charge** | Charge roots the target for 2 seconds after you reach it. |
|  | 🏃 **Long Charge** | Charge reaches 10 yards further. |
|  | 🛡️ **Intercept** | Target an ally or yourself and Charge becomes Intercept: you rush to your ally (you stay put if you target yourself) and the target takes 20% less damage for 4 seconds. |
| II | ⚡ **Quick Hands** | Attack speed is 20% faster. |
|  | 🛡️ **Iron Constitution** | +10% maximum health. |
|  | 💪 **Savage Might** | +10% damage. |
| IV | 🧿 **Cleansing Charm** | A trinket button beside your bar: removes every harmful effect from you (stuns and fears included). 60 second cooldown, no global cooldown, works while stunned. |
|  | 🛡️ **Warding Charm** | A trinket button beside your bar: a shield absorbing 20% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. 60 second cooldown, no global cooldown, works while stunned. |
|  | 💚 **Healing Charm** | A trinket button beside your bar: heals you for 25% of your maximum health. 60 second cooldown, no global cooldown, works while stunned. |
| V | 📢 **Terrifying Roar** | Learn Intimidating Shout: a fear in 8 yards that breaks on damage. Replaces Heroic Leap. → [Intimidating Shout](#skill-intimidating-shout) |
|  | 💖 **Savage Mending** | Learn Enraged Regeneration: for 8 seconds you heal for 300% of the damage you deal. Replaces Heroic Leap. → [Enraged Regeneration](#skill-enraged-regeneration) |
|  | 🚩 **Rallying Banner** | Learn Battle Banner: plant a banner for 12 seconds; you and your allies near it deal 10% more damage and take 10% less. Replaces Heroic Leap. → [Battle Banner](#skill-battle-banner) |

## Mage

Ranged caster. Slows, roots and polymorphs. Fragile, so keep your distance.

- **Health:** 2400
- **Mana:** 1000 max, start with 1000, +24 a second
- **Specs:** [Cryomancy](#mage-frost) (Control / kiting) · [Pyromancy](#mage-fire) (Burst damage) · [Starweaving](#mage-arcane) (Sustain / utility)

**Talents every Mage spec shares** (one pick per tier, kept when you change spec):

| Tier | Talent | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| I | ⚡ **Twin Blink** | Blink holds two charges, each recharging on its own timer. A number on the button shows how many are ready. |
|  | 🌀 **Blink and Cast** | Blink can be used in the middle of a cast, and the spell keeps casting. |
|  | ❄️ **Frozen Departure** | Blink releases a Frost Nova where you stood before you blink away. |
| II | ⏩ **Quickened Casting** | Casting time and the global cooldown are 10% shorter. |
|  | ❤️ **Hardy Mage** | +10% maximum health. |
|  | 💥 **Arcane Might** | +10% damage. |
| IV | 🧿 **Cleansing Charm** | A trinket button beside your bar: removes every harmful effect from you (stuns and fears included). 60 second cooldown, no global cooldown, works while stunned. |
|  | 🛡️ **Warding Charm** | A trinket button beside your bar: a shield absorbing 20% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. 60 second cooldown, no global cooldown, works while stunned. |
|  | 💚 **Healing Charm** | A trinket button beside your bar: heals you for 25% of your maximum health. 60 second cooldown, no global cooldown, works while stunned. |
| V | 🪞 **Illusionist** | Learn Mirror Image: enemies lose their target on you, and for 8 seconds two images of you (1 health, 80% less damage) fight at your side. Replaces Polymorph or Counterspell (you choose). → [Mirror Image](#skill-mirror-image) |
|  | 🧘 **Arcane Recovery** | Learn Evocation: for 6 seconds you heal 2% of your maximum health every second, regain mana 4 times as fast and take 15% less damage. Replaces Polymorph or Counterspell (you choose). → [Evocation](#skill-evocation) |
|  | 🌠 **Runecaster** | Learn Rune of Power: a rune at your feet for 12 seconds; while you stand in it you deal 15% more damage and your casts are 15% shorter. Replaces Polymorph or Counterspell (you choose). → [Rune of Power](#skill-rune-of-power) |

## Priest

Healer and support. Shields, heals, dispels and fears. Mana-hungry.

- **Health:** 2500
- **Mana:** 1000 max, start with 1000, +15 a second
- **Specs:** [Warden](#priest-discipline) (Shield healer) · [Lightbearer](#priest-holy) (Pure healer) · [Gloomweaver](#priest-shadow) (Damage)

|  | 🏃 **Fleeing Scream** | Psychic Scream makes enemies run as far from you as they can instead of running at random. |

|  | 🛡️ **Warding Charm** | A trinket button beside your bar: a shield absorbing 20% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. 60 second cooldown, no global cooldown, works while stunned. |
|  | 💚 **Healing Charm** | A trinket button beside your bar: heals you for 25% of your maximum health. 60 second cooldown, no global cooldown, works while stunned. |

<a id="rogue-subtlety"></a>
### 👤 Shade · Control / mobility

Slippery repositioning with Shadowstep and Sprint. Backstab hits twice as hard from behind; Weak Point finishes.

- **Weapon:** Twin Daggers
- **Auto-attack:** 50 damage every 1.8s, 3 yd reach

| Key | Skill | Numbers with this spec |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Stealth](#skill-stealth) | Instant · 10s cooldown |
| 2 | [Kidney Shot](#skill-kidney-shot) | 25 energy · 3 yd range · Instant · 30s cooldown · 2s stun (+0.8s per combo point, up to 6s) |
| 3 | [Kick](#skill-kick) | 3 yd range · Instant · 15s cooldown |
| 4 | [Shadowstep](#skill-shadowstep) | 10 energy · 25 yd range · min 5 yd · Instant · 20s cooldown |
| 5 | [Vanish](#skill-vanish) | Instant · 120s cooldown |
| 6 | [Sprint](#skill-sprint) | Instant · 60s cooldown · 8s speed boost |
| 7 | [Backstab](#skill-backstab) | 40 energy · 3 yd range · Instant |
| 8 | [Weak Point](#skill-eviscerate) | 35 energy · 3 yd range · Instant · +1s per combo point, up to 5s damage over time |

**Talents** (one per tier; tiers I and II and IV and V are under [Rogue](#rogue)):

| Tier | Talent | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| III | 🔪 **Efficient Backstab** | Backstab costs 10% less energy. |
|  | 👤 **Shadow Flicker** | Backstab has a 10% chance to first Shadowstep you behind the target for free (no combo points). |
|  | 🦶 **Hobbling Backstab** | Backstab slows the target by 10% for 3 seconds. |

### Rogue skills

Base numbers, before spec and talent changes (in game, hover a skill to see yours).

<a id="skill-stealth"></a>
#### Stealth

*Physical* · Instant · 10s cooldown

- Hidden from enemies farther than 2 yards. Broken by damage or attacking.
- *Cannot be used in combat.*
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

On the bar: [Cutthroat](#rogue-assassination) (key 1), [Duelist](#rogue-combat) (key 1), [Shade](#rogue-subtlety) (key 1).

<a id="skill-mutilate"></a>
#### Mutilate

*Physical* · 50 energy · 3 yd range · Instant · 6s bleed

- Deals 155 physical damage.
- Bleeding: takes 14 physical damage every 1s (84 total).
- *Awards 1 combo point.*
- *While you are stealthed this slot becomes Cheap Shot.*

On the bar: [Cutthroat](#rogue-assassination) (key 2).

<a id="skill-kidney-shot"></a>
#### Kidney Shot

*Physical* · 25 energy · 3 yd range · Instant · 30s cooldown · 2s stun (+0.8s per combo point, up to 6s)

- Cannot move, cast or act.
- *Spends all combo points (needs at least 1).*

On the bar: [Cutthroat](#rogue-assassination) (key 3), [Duelist](#rogue-combat) (key 3), [Shade](#rogue-subtlety) (key 2).

<a id="skill-kick"></a>
#### Kick

*Physical* · 3 yd range · Instant · 15s cooldown

- Interrupts the target's spellcasting and locks out that school for 5s.
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

On the bar: [Cutthroat](#rogue-assassination) (key 4), [Duelist](#rogue-combat) (key 4), [Shade](#rogue-subtlety) (key 3).

<a id="skill-vanish"></a>
#### Vanish

*Physical* · Instant · 120s cooldown

- Removes every harmful effect from you.
- Drops you out of combat: enemies lose their target on you and spells aimed at you are cancelled.
- You gain Stealth: Hidden from enemies farther than 2 yards. Broken by damage or attacking.
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*
- Effects: [Stealth](#effect-stealth)

On the bar: [Cutthroat](#rogue-assassination) (key 5), [Duelist](#rogue-combat) (key 6), [Shade](#rogue-subtlety) (key 5).

<a id="skill-sprint"></a>
#### Sprint

*Physical* · Instant · 60s cooldown · 8s speed boost

- Movement speed increased by 70%.
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

On the bar: [Cutthroat](#rogue-assassination) (key 6), [Duelist](#rogue-combat) (key 7), [Shade](#rogue-subtlety) (key 6).

<a id="skill-garrote"></a>
#### Garrote

*Physical* · 40 energy · 3 yd range · Instant · 30s cooldown · 8s bleed

- Deals 100 physical damage.
- Bleeding: takes 50 physical damage every 1s (400 total).

On the bar: [Cutthroat](#rogue-assassination) (key 7).

<a id="skill-exsanguinate"></a>
#### Exsanguinate

*Physical* · 35 energy · 3 yd range · Instant

- Deals 60 damage per combo point spent plus 50% of the bleed damage remaining on the target, then makes every current bleed deal 3x damage (using it again does not stack).
- *Spends all combo points (needs at least 1).*

On the bar: [Cutthroat](#rogue-assassination) (key 8).

<a id="skill-sinister-strike"></a>
#### Sinister Strike

*Physical* · 40 energy · 3 yd range · Instant

- Deals 110 physical damage.
- *Awards 1 combo point.*
- *While you are stealthed this slot becomes Cheap Shot.*

On the bar: [Duelist](#rogue-combat) (key 2).

<a id="skill-adrenaline-rush"></a>
#### Adrenaline Rush

*Physical* · Instant · 15s cooldown · 4s buff (+1.5s per combo point)

- +60% energy regeneration. +42.9% auto attack speed. Heals 2% of maximum health every 1s.
- *Spends all combo points (needs at least 1).*
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

On the bar: [Duelist](#rogue-combat) (key 5).

<a id="skill-gouge"></a>
#### Gouge

*Physical* · 25 energy · 3 yd range · Instant · 20s cooldown · 4s incapacitate

- Cannot move, cast or act. Breaks on damage.

On the bar: [Duelist](#rogue-combat) (key 8).

<a id="skill-shadowstep"></a>
#### Shadowstep

*Physical* · 10 energy · 25 yd range · min 5 yd · Instant · 20s cooldown

- Rushes to the target and lands behind it, turning you to face it.
- *Awards 3 combo points.*
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

On the bar: [Shade](#rogue-subtlety) (key 4).

<a id="skill-backstab"></a>
#### Backstab

*Physical* · 40 energy · 3 yd range · Instant

- Deals 110 physical damage.
- *Awards 1 combo point.*
- *While you are stealthed this slot becomes Cheap Shot.*

On the bar: [Shade](#rogue-subtlety) (key 7).

<a id="skill-eviscerate"></a>
#### Weak Point

*Physical* · 35 energy · 3 yd range · Instant · +1s per combo point, up to 5s damage over time

- Takes 110 physical damage every 1s for each combo point spent. Silenced and disarmed: cannot cast spells, auto attack or use physical abilities.
- *Spends all combo points (needs at least 1).*

On the bar: [Shade](#rogue-subtlety) (key 8).

<a id="skill-blind"></a>
#### Blind

*Physical* · 30 energy · 15 yd range · Instant · 60s cooldown · 5s incapacitate

- Removes damage over time and fear effects from the target.
- Cannot move, cast or act. Breaks on damage.

Talent: Cutthroat tier V *Blinding Powder* (replaces Sprint); Duelist tier V *Blinding Powder* (replaces Sprint); Shade tier V *Blinding Powder* (replaces Sprint).

<a id="skill-evasion"></a>
#### Evasion

*Physical* · Instant · 60s cooldown · 6s buff

- −45% damage taken.
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

Talent: Cutthroat tier V *Evasive Dancer* (replaces Sprint); Duelist tier V *Evasive Dancer* (replaces Sprint); Shade tier V *Evasive Dancer* (replaces Sprint).

<a id="skill-sap"></a>
#### Sap

*Physical* · 35 energy · 7 yd range · Instant · 8s incapacitate

- Cannot move, cast or act. Breaks on damage.
- *Requires stealth.*

Talent: Cutthroat tier V *Sapper* (replaces Kidney Shot); Duelist tier V *Sapper* (replaces Kidney Shot); Shade tier V *Sapper* (replaces Kidney Shot).

<a id="skill-cheap-shot"></a>
#### Cheap Shot

*Physical* · 40 energy · 3 yd range · Instant · 4s stun

- Cannot move, cast or act.
- *Requires stealth.*

While you are stealthed it takes the slot of [Sinister Strike](#skill-sinister-strike), [Backstab](#skill-backstab), [Mutilate](#skill-mutilate).

<a id="trinkets"></a>
## Trinkets

Tier IV of every class gives an extra button beside the action bar (bind it to any key in the key settings). It costs no mana, rage or energy and shares the global cooldown.

<a id="skill-trinket-cleanse"></a>
#### Cleansing Charm

*Holy* · Instant · 60s cooldown

- Removes every harmful effect from you.
- *Usable while locked out.*
- *Works even while polymorphed or disoriented.*
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

Talent: tier IV *Cleansing Charm*.

<a id="skill-trinket-shield"></a>
#### Warding Charm

*Holy* · Instant · 60s cooldown · 8s shield

- Absorbs 20% of your max health.
- *Usable while locked out.*
- *Works while stunned, feared or rooted, but not while Polymorph or Dragon's Breath holds you.*
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

Talent: tier IV *Warding Charm*.

<a id="skill-trinket-heal"></a>
#### Healing Charm

*Holy* · Instant · 60s cooldown

- Heals you for 25% of your maximum health.
- *Usable while locked out.*
- *Works while stunned, feared or rooted, but not while Polymorph or Dragon's Breath holds you.*
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

Talent: tier IV *Healing Charm*.
